title.rendered: MSD Project Clear Responds to Overflow in Maryland Heights

content.rendered:
MSD Project Clear (MSDPC) is cleaning up after a wastewater overflow in Maryland Heights. It was discovered late Wednesday afternoon in an industrial area along Example Blvd. Crews cleared the blocked pipe that caused the overflow.

While there is no immediate threat to health or safety, everyone is asked to avoid direct contact with Fee Fee Creek east of Example Road until the cleanup is complete and the warning signs are removed.

A force main is a sewer line that uses pumps.

title.rendered: MSD Project Clear Responds to Force Main Break in Example Heights

content.rendered: MSD Project Clear is responding to a force main break. The break was discovered late Wednesday morning near Example Road. Crews contained the overflow to a small, wooded area.

title.rendered: Repairs Complete at Force Main Break in Example Heights

content.rendered: Repairs to the force main break were completed Friday.
